sections.changelog:
Added

  • **Supplier text is now cleaned up on import.** Price lists often arrive with text mangled by the exporter — `Bluetooth-гарнитура "Saches" R3` instead of proper quotes — and with non-breaking spaces glued into names. Such text is now decoded to its intended form, and invisible characters (non-breaking space, zero-width space, soft hyphen, byte-order mark) are removed, so product names, descriptions and category names arrive in the catalogue readable. Product descriptions keep their HTML and their line breaks, and text such as «вес < 5 кг, длина > 2 м» is preserved intact. Article numbers and barcodes are deliberately left byte-for-byte as supplied, since they are matching keys. Categories created earlier with mangled names are repaired on the next import, while manual renames are kept.

Fixed

  • **A dedicated article-number column now wins over the generic offer id.** When a YML feed ships both an `` attribute and a `` element, the article number is taken from `vendorCode`; previously whichever came first in the file won. Feeds that carry only the offer id keep using it, as before.
  • **Column detection no longer misses columns with invisible characters.** A header such as «Розничнаяцена» is now recognised. The saved mapping still stores the original header, so existing setups are unaffected.
  • **Empty detection result is no longer reported as success.** When a price list contains no products, the field-mapping screen said «0 columns detected» with a green badge; it now shows a warning explaining that the file holds no products.
